overview_description.description: YZ Buyer is a wholesale sourcing and distribution company specializing in footwear, apparel, leather goods, fashion accessories, and lifestyle products. The company connects manufacturers with retailers and bulk buyers through global sourcing, private labeling, and wholesale supply solutions. Serving international markets, YZ Buyer focuses on quality manufacturing, competitive pricing, efficient logistics, and customized procurement services for businesses in the fashion and retail industries worldwide.
